leads.title: Utah SB 296 (2015) - Statewide Antidiscrimination Law
leads.documents: Bans discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment and housing (public accommodation not included) with exemptions for religious organizations and affiliates; also protects employee speech on religious/moral beliefs.
leads.detail: Passed Utah Senate March 6, 2015 in 23-5 vote; approved House March 11 in 65-10 vote; signed by Governor Gary Herbert March 12, 2015; backed by LDS Church

leads.title: Utah Hate Crimes Amendments (2019)
leads.documents: Criminalizes hate crimes based on sexual orientation or gender identity and provides enhanced penalty; builds on H.B.111 Hate Crimes Statistics Act and H.B.112 Hate Crimes Penalties of 1992.
leads.detail: Senate approved March 5, 2019 in 18-11 vote; House approved with amendment March 12 in 64-9 vote with 2 abstentions; Senate concurred same day 22-3; signed by Governor April 2, 2019

leads.title: Utah Supreme Court ruling May 2021 on birth certificates
leads.documents: Holds 4-1 that state judges must grant sex and name changes on personal birth certificates to transgender individuals who have met certain clinical requirements; establishes court-order process via Utah Office of Vital Records without surgery requirement.
leads.detail: May 2021 4-1 decision; State declined to present counter-argument; Office of Vital Records must register amendment and issue certified copy without additional cost

leads.title: Utah House Bill 11 (2022) - Transgender Athlete Sports Ban
leads.documents: Bans transgender athletes from girls sports/athletics/Olympics; documents veto, override, and judicial reversal to case-by-case consideration.
leads.detail: Passed Legislature March 2022; vetoed by Governor Spencer Cox March 22; Legislature overrode veto, ban took effect July 1; judge reversed ban August 19 for 2022-2023 school year for case-by-case consideration

leads.title: Utah Gender-Affirming Healthcare Ban (January 2023)
leads.documents: Prohibits doctors from providing gender-affirming care to trans people under 18; allows care under 25 but gives patient ability to retroactively disaffirm consent and sue; grandfathers youth already receiving care in January 2023.
leads.detail: House passed Jan 26, 2023; Senate passed Jan 27 in 20-8 vote; signed by Governor Spencer Cox Jan 28, took effect immediately; legislative legal review found potentially unconstitutional

leads.title: U.S. Department of Justice Investigation - Utah Department of Corrections (March 2024)
leads.documents: Federal investigation finding that Utah Department of Corrections discriminated against an inmate by denying gender-affirming hormones.
leads.detail: March 2024 DOJ finding of discrimination by denial of gender-affirming hormones in corrections custody

leads.title: Utah Systematic Review on Pediatric Gender Dysphoria Treatments (May 2025)
leads.documents: Two-year systematic review commissioned as part of youth healthcare ban concluding treatments are effective for mental health, psychosocial outcomes and body changes consistent with affirmed gender, and safe for bone density, cardiovascular, metabolic and cancer risk.
leads.detail: May 2025 review commissioned by state; findings dismissed by Utah state legislature which kept ban in place

leads.title: Utah Bathroom Bill (2024)
leads.documents: Requires people to use bathrooms and locker rooms in government-owned buildings including public schools by sex assigned at birth; requires birth certificate and if amended, proof of gender-affirming surgery when challenged; creates formal complaint process.
leads.detail: Passed Legislature early January; signed by Governor Spencer Cox Jan 30; does not affect private businesses; May 2024 state provided way for officials/individuals to file formal complaints

leads.title: Utah 2024 Student Housing / Dorms Restriction
leads.documents: Bans transgender students from dorms aligning with gender identity; follows incident where transgender woman assigned to girls dorm at Utah State University and viral social media complaint by parent.
leads.detail: 2024 bill after Utah State University girls dorm assignment incident and viral post about sharing suite

leads.title: Utah LGBTQ Pride Flag Ban (March 2025) and Salt Lake City Response
leads.documents: Explicit ban on any LGBTQ pride flags within grounds of all public schools and government buildings; documents state restriction on expression and municipal workaround.
leads.detail: New law implemented March 2025; in response May 2025 Salt Lake City adopted Sego Belonging Flag based on Progress Pride flag and Sego Visibility Flag based on transgender pride flag as official flags
